card.name: Container words before the item inside
card.fires_on: Container or unit-of-count words such as packet, rolls of, package of, can, sprig and ampule, right after a quantity in ingredient, supply or dose lists. The next word is the item that fills the container.

modes.label: Recipe and supply lists
modes.description: Container or count words after a number in ingredient or materials lists, often followed by the item itself.

modes.label: Drug packaging units
modes.description: Packet, ampule or package of, naming the unit that holds a drug product.

card.writes: It seems to push toward gel-like or material nouns that name the contents, though the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on words like packet, roll, can or ampule that name a container just before the thing inside it.
